dbPath.label: Database path
dbPath.help: Optional override for the agenr knowledge database. Defaults to the dbPath in agenr's config.json, then ~/.agenr/knowledge.db.

configPath.label: Config path
configPath.help: Optional path to agenr's config.json. Defaults to AGENR_CONFIG_PATH, then config.json next to dbPath when dbPath is set, then ~/.agenr/config.json.
